harper: quick flag — saw token drift on magnet-13b-q3 when we insert a tiny system msg mid-gen
ryan: how reproducible?
harper: ~60% on my canary. seq=32k, reinject at ~8k. fp32 clean, q3 shows insertion/skip at ~8,042.
zoe: logs?
harper: short log: 
[2026-04-10T10:04:11Z] kv_pack_offset: 1284
[2026-04-10T10:04:11Z] rope_anchor: 0x4d20 -> 0x4d10 (delta -16)
[2026-04-10T10:04:11Z] top_token(actual): "ing" vs expected "ed"
ryan: delta -16 points to pack-alignment rounding on small writes. tried rotary_rescale toggle?
harper: rescale reduces freq but doesn't remove. padding the reinjected sys to 64b boundary drops failure to ~2%. prefix_cache_disable=true eliminates it.
zoe: plan: add lightweight instrumentation (kv_pack_offset, rope_anchor, head_phase_checksum, top5_logits) around injection and run fp32/q3/q4hyb on dedicated GPU. if prefix_disable fixes, likely allocator packing issue -> options: allocate small-insert writes with stable offsets or run re-anchor after reinject.
deploy-bot: canary: magnet-13b-q3-packprobe deployed to pool-canary-9 (sha: a1b2c3)
harper: filing ML-13002 with raw logs, will upload harness results tomorrow. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre for allocator parity checks.
ryan: nice repro. add regression to longcontext-suite (midstream-sys-insert). :mag:
